name: cancel-happy-path
pins: PRD story 20: cancelling names exactly which appointment, and nothing is cancelled until the patient confirms. The plan is `cancel` alone - no routing, and above all no required-documents diff, which would open a task telling the patient to prepare for the visit they are calling off. This scenario exists because cancel had no path from a patient message at all until Phase 6a: the tools were built and tested and nothing could reach them.

turns.message: I want to cancel my appointment
